_comment: The near-Tactician fixture. post_tutorial shape (warrior L1, met/sparred/given_spear, both weapons carried) PLUS studied_the_cellar:1 banked (the [Tactician] gate the Missing-Crate guile path banks), standing at the inn (2,3) facing right. field_skills_loop LOADS this so its NEXT sleep grants [Tactician] with the honest 'past cleverness pays off' bank -- and because that sleep follows the loop's basic_cleaning use (cleaned_the_inn:1), the SAME sleep ALSO grants [Helper] (gained_by cleaned_the_inn:1): the overworld bar grows 1 -> 3 field slots ([Basic Cleaning], [Basic Cooking], [Appraise Foe]). No combat in the path, so rng_state is cosmetic; kept 9 for convention. equipped weapon (rusty_sword) is a subset of inventory (save.gd contract). TRAP: rng_state is a properly-derived state (.seed=9, captured .state), never hand-typed -- WISave restores .state directly, not .seed. This fixture's own canonical never resolves a fight to completion off this rng_state, so its exact value is cosmetic/inert for outcome purposes.
